subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Launched in 2016, this scheme provides free LPG (cooking gas) connections to women from below-poverty-line households, aiming to replace polluting traditional cooking fuels (like firewood) and reduce indoor air pollution. It is called:
explanation: Ujjwala Yojana specifically targets clean cooking fuel access for poor women — distinct from Ayushman Bharat (health insurance), Jan Dhan Yojana (bank account access), or the Saubhagya Scheme (household electrification).

subject: General Knowledge & Current Affairs
stem: Launched in 2015, this scheme provides collateral-free loans (up to ₹10 lakh, in three categories — Shishu, Kishor, Tarun) to small and micro non-corporate businesses to promote entrepreneurship. It is called:
explanation: MUDRA (Micro Units Development and Refinance Agency) Yojana provides small collateral-free loans to micro-enterprises — distinct from Stand-Up India (specifically targets SC/ST and women entrepreneurs with larger loans) or the Atal Pension Yojana (retirement savings for unorganised-sector workers).
